declaration.preface:
Choksi (CHPL) is committed to upholding and safeguarding the fundamental rights of all employees, ensuring a fair, respectful, and inclusive work environment. This policy establishes the framework for promoting ethical labor practices, fostering diversity, and providing a safe and dignified workplace.

CHPL recognizes the importance of equitable treatment, non-discrimination, and fair wages while strictly prohibiting any form of forced or child labor. Employees are empowered with freedom of association, the right to collective bargaining, and access to grievance mechanisms without fear of retaliation.

Aligned with international labor standards and legal requirements, CHPL continuously strives to enhance workplace conditions, employee well-being, and professional growth opportunities. Through this commitment, the company reinforces its dedication to ethical employment practices, ensuring that every individual is treated with respect, fairness, and integrity.
declaration.declaration: Choksi (CHPL) recognizes that employees are the foundation of its success and is committed to fostering a workplace that upholds dignity, equality, and fairness. This policy ensures that all employees are provided with opportunities for growth, a safe and inclusive work environment, and protection from any form of discrimination or exploitation. CHPL is dedicated to maintaining transparent communication, ensuring employee participation in decision-making processes, and regularly reviewing labor practices to align with evolving legal and ethical standards.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, including full-time, part-time, contractual, and temporary workers, as well as contractors and business partners of Choksi (CHPL). It covers fair wages, non-discrimination, workplace safety, freedom of association, and the prevention of forced or child labor. CHPL ensures compliance with labor laws and human rights standards, promoting a workplace based on dignity, equality, and ethical practices.

focusAreas: Ethical Labor Practices & Human Rights Protection

Safe & Healthy Work Environment: Regularly enhance health and safety protocols to proactively address workplace risks and promote employee well-being.
Fair & Supportive Workplace Practices: Promote a workplace culture that prioritizes ethical practices, psychological safety, and employee satisfaction.
Open Communication & Employee Participat: Foster open dialogue through structured communication channels and inclusive participation in workplace decision-making.
Growth & Development Opportunities: To conduct annual performance reviews to support career advancement and encourage internal mobility by promoting from within when possible.
Ethical Labor Practices & Human Rights P: Enforce and maintain zero-tolerance policies on child and forced labor throughout our operations.
Inclusive & Equitable Work Culture: Promote an inclusive environment that respects individual differences and ensures equitable access to opportunities.
Responsible Business Partnerships: Extend employee rights and labor standards through the supply chain by aligning with responsible suppliers and vendors.
Competitive & Transparent Compensation: Ensure employees receive industry-competitive wages and benefits with transparent pay structures.
Benchmark compensation packages every year to align with industry standards.
Workplace Integrity & Respect: Maintain a harassment-free environment through education, zero-tolerance policies, and clear redressal systems.

policy.monitoring:
Choksi Heraeus is committed to maintaining transparency in the implementation of its Employee Rights Policy by establishing a structured monitoring and reporting framework. Key aspects such as fair labor practices, working conditions, equal opportunity, and grievance resolution will be regularly tracked and documented. Periodic internal reviews and audits will be conducted to assess compliance with labor laws, company policies, and social responsibility standards.

Key indicators related to employee well-being and rights will be evaluated, and findings will be reported to senior management and relevant internal stakeholders. Additionally, an annual internal review of employee rights performance will be carried out, highlighting progress, identifying areas for improvement, and guiding future actions to ensure accountability, inclusivity, and continuous improvement in our workplace practices.
policy.reviewMechanism: The HR Manager at Choksi Heraeus will conduct annual reviews to evaluate the effectiveness of the employee rights policy, ensure compliance with applicable standards, and revise targets where necessary. The review process involves analyzing quarterly reports, collecting employee feedback, and benchmarking practices against industry standards. Key findings are reported to the CEO, and necessary adjustments are made to uphold continuous improvement in labor and human rights practices across all operations.
